prompt: The farmer (say / tell) his cousin how to call the farm dog using three short sounds.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell используется прямое дополнение (his cousin) и придаточное с вопросительным словом (how to call).

prompt: While waiting at the stop, commuters repeated what the radio presenter had (say / tell) about the roadworks blocking the downtown avenue.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не требует личного дополнения после себя и употребляется с конструкцией what + subject + say.

prompt: Refusing to write anything down, my aunt (say / tell) me to add a pinch of oregano only after tasting the sauce.
explanation_ru: Для передачи инструкции или побуждения к действию используется модель tell + дополнение (me) + инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: During the interview, the gardener (say / tell) the police officer that a white van had been parked outside her neighbor's gate all afternoon.
explanation_ru: Когда сразу после глагола речи указан адресат (the police officer), используется глагол tell, а не say.

prompt: Before the harvest began, the orchard owner (say / tell) the seasonal workers how to twist ripe apples gently without damaging next year's buds.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell сочетается с прямым дополнением (the seasonal workers) и вопросительной конструкцией how to do something.

prompt: The handwritten note taped to the front door (say / tell) that we should hide the birthday parcel behind the garden shed before Dad got home.
explanation_ru: С неодушевленными источниками текста (a note) без указания адресата используется глагол say в конструкции say that...

prompt: During the commercial break, the floor manager used hand signals and quickly (say / tell) the host to wrap up her next segment early.
explanation_ru: Модель tell + somebody + to do something применяется для передачи распоряжений и указаний конкретному человеку.

prompt: Sending back the cold steak, the diner angrily repeated what the waiter had (say / tell) him about the dish being freshly grilled.
explanation_ru: Наличие личного местоимения him сразу после глагола требует употребления формы told.

prompt: With only ten minutes before the graduation dinner, Leo texted and (say / tell) me which exit to take from the subway station.
explanation_ru: После tell следует прямое дополнение (me) и придаточное с союзным словом which.

prompt: To keep the nervous donor calm, the nurse cracked a joke and (say / tell) him to rest for ten minutes and drink plenty of orange juice.
explanation_ru: Для передачи совета или медицинской рекомендации конкретному лицу используется конструкция tell + him + to-infinitive.

prompt: Ahead of next week's archive workshop, the local historian sent an email to all participants. First, she (say / tell) everyone to wear cotton gloves when touching the nineteenth-century family albums. She also (say / tell) that direct sunlight could fade the ink within minutes, so guests should keep the folders closed until scanning.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске есть адресат и инфинитив (told everyone to wear), во втором адресат не указан и сразу идет придаточное с that (said that).

prompt: The lifeguard walked over to the parents unloading giant inflatable flamingos by the diving lanes. She politely (say / tell) to them that large floats were banned in the main pool before noon. Then she (say / tell) them to use the shallow family pool on the other side of the deck instead.
explanation_ru: Глагол say требует предлога to перед адресатом (said to them that), тогда как tell присоединяет дополнение без предлога (told them to use).

prompt: During the morning test shift, the head cook checked whether the new worker could handle the busy time. He (say / tell) the young cook how to roll the cold pastry into tight shapes without warming the butter. After watching the first pan, he (say / tell) that the speed was great for a beginner.
explanation_ru: В первом случае после глагола стоит дополнение (told the young cook how to roll), а во втором сразу следует придаточное предложение (said that).

prompt: Mistaking a stacked cardboard installation for a bench, a tired tourist sat right down on the corner of it. A security guard rushed over and (say / tell) him to stand up immediately. When the visitor apologized, the guard (say / tell) that the piece was actually worth forty thousand euros.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется tell + him + to-infinitive для команды; во втором после глагола нет адресата, поэтому нужен глагол said.

prompt: A tourist picked up a rare 1962 jazz LP from behind the counter and asked for the price. The shop owner (speak / talk) in slow, simple English so the customer could follow easily. He (say / tell) the buyer that a regular collector had already reserved the record by phone that morning.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения языка общения используется глагол speak (spoke in simple English), а для передачи информации конкретному собеседнику — told the buyer that.

prompt: At the school gate, Maya ___ the other parents to bring old family photographs for tomorrow's history project.
explanation_ru: Только глагол tell (told) используется в конструкции «глагол + дополнение (the other parents) + to-infinitive».

prompt: A printed sign at the cinema entrance ___ that the main projector is broken and explains how guests can claim a full refund.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идет о содержании вывески или объявления без указания адресата, используется глагол say (says that).

prompt: The customer leaned over the counter and ___ the florist exactly what words to print on the anniversary card.
explanation_ru: После глагола идет прямое дополнение (the florist) и вопросительное слово (what), что требует употребления глагола told.

prompt: Before the race started, the cycling judge ___ the repair worker that the rider's bike bars were a little too wide.
explanation_ru: Поскольку сразу после глагола указан получатель сообщения (the repair worker), правильный вариант — told.

prompt: During lunch, Dan said his work friends that the new chat app makes a loud sound even when his phone is on silent.
answer: During lunch, Dan told his work friends that the new chat app makes a loud sound even when his phone is on silent.
accepted_answers: During lunch, Dan told his work friends that the new chat app makes a loud sound even when his phone is on silent.
During lunch, Dan said to his work friends that the new chat app makes a loud sound even when his phone is on silent.
explanation_ru: После глагола say нельзя ставить личное дополнение без предлога to; правильно использовать told his work friends или said to his work friends.

prompt: The ticket officer softly woke the sleeping student and told her that her train car would be left behind at the next station.
answer: The ticket officer softly woke the sleeping student and told her that her train car would be left behind at the next station.
accepted_answers: The ticket officer softly woke the sleeping student and told her that her train car would be left behind at the next station.
explanation_ru: Предложение грамматически верно: использована правильная модель told + дополнение (her) + придаточное с that.

prompt: Hearing a strange noise under the floor, a passenger called a worker on the plane, who calmly said him what the engine was doing.
answer: Hearing a strange noise under the floor, a passenger called a worker on the plane, who calmly told him what the engine was doing.
accepted_answers: Hearing a strange noise under the floor, a passenger called a worker on the plane, who calmly told him what the engine was doing.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не сочетается с прямым личным дополнением (him); для передачи объяснения конкретному человеку нужен глагол told.

prompt: A student in the library whispers to ask where the quiet zone is, not realizing she is already sitting in it. Which response is grammatically correct?
options: The librarian smiled and said her she was already in the quiet zone.
The librarian smiled and told her she was already in the quiet zone.
The librarian smiled and told to her she was already in the quiet zone.
The librarian smiled and spoke her she was already in the quiet zone.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу ставится прямое дополнение без предлога (told her), тогда как say и speak так не употребляются.

prompt: Rewrite the sentence using 'said' instead of 'told me': As heavy rain began to fall, Mark told me that the morning forecast had promised clear skies.
answer: As heavy rain began to fall, Mark said that the morning forecast had promised clear skies.
accepted_answers: As heavy rain began to fall, Mark said that the morning forecast had promised clear skies.
As heavy rain began to fall, Mark said the morning forecast had promised clear skies.
As heavy rain began to fall, Mark said to me that the morning forecast had promised clear skies.
explanation_ru: При замене told me на said личное дополнение убирается (или присоединяется через предлог to), и после глагола сразу следует придаточное предложение.
